Room to grow

Safe spaces. A growing school.

Improve sanitation, prepare three new classrooms and secure the school grounds.

01

The need

The school has three classrooms and two latrines according to the project brief. The priority is four additional sanitation units, with separate facilities for girls and boys, accessible entry and handwashing.

The proposed response

Prepare a technical assessment and quotations for sanitation. Then plan a building for three upper-primary classes, furniture, fencing and improvements to the school grounds.

Next steps

  1. 01

    Sanitation assessment and comparable quotations

  2. 02

    Technical approval, funding allocation and maintenance

  3. 03

    Building proposal for the 2027 school year

Who will benefit?

The Beog-Zaadba school community. Scope and beneficiary numbers will be approved for each stage before launch.
